definitions.hash: Keccak round_update or SHA256 rounds/feed-forward; these have attribution priority.
definitions.hash_template_nonhash: Accepted explicit HASH command edge through command_done/seq_complete sampled edge inclusive, excluding Hash clocks.
definitions.recipe_nonhash: Accepted recipe request through consumed recipe response inclusive, excluding Hash clocks; subset of HASH-template clocks.
definitions.control_fetch: Sequencer FETCH using current program_data opcode, not stale token.
definitions.control_issue: Sequencer LOAD with current control token.
definitions.control_wait: Sequencer WAIT_CONTROL; may include actual RAM/I/O completion.
definitions.joint_histogram: Only Remaining clocks, pre-positive-edge executor/sequencer/control token/formatter/hash phase snapshot.
